coordinates: Metres east/up/north relative to the fixed site datum in each terrain response.
terrain_evidence: *-footing-ground.json retains direct production8m-pitch samples at the actual outward support edges. New support edges subdivide at no more than6m. These are provider rendering ground measurements, not a conservation survey.
support_rule: Preserve existing architectural floor/crown levels. Wall strips, mapped building plinths and ramp sides extend their toes to at least0.5m below sampled terrain. Battered-wall relief courses interpolate on the final sloping faces. Roofs, window frames and columns on fully enclosed podium volumes are not independent terrain footings.

scope.el-morro: Batteries sample the outward scarp toes; three switchback ramps have retaining sides to ground. Lighthouse and garitas are supported by the authored batteries.
